meta.note: Build-vs-buy fuses your comps with sourced construction/land/waterfront cost benchmarks (config.costs). Costs are external market estimates — directional, not a bid. Sources in docs/MARKET_REALITIES.md.

market_facts.fact: New luxury custom construction runs about $600–$900/sqft in South Florida; ultra-premium waterfront exceeds $1,500–$2,000/sqft (hard cost; add ~25% soft costs).
Waterfront is priced per linear foot of frontage from same-waterbody comps — depth, bridge clearance (no fixed bridges = ocean access) and exposure drive it more than interior square footage.
Seawall replacement runs $300–$900/linear foot; a new dock $35,000–$75,000; a boat lift about $1/lb (a 24,000-lb lift ≈ $38k).
Insurance/carrying on luxury waterfront: canal $8,000–$20,000/yr, Intracoastal $12,000–$30,000, oceanfront $18,000–$60,000+.
Ultra-luxury is deep: 361 South Florida homes sold above $10M in 2025 — the 2nd-highest year ever (2021 = 444) — Broward logged its first $70M sale, and the market now trades $20M–$50M+.
Broadly Fort Lauderdale ran a buyer's market in 2025 (~9.8 months of inventory); the top end still moves on scarcity of finished waterfront product and cash / international demand.
